title: AlignPage and DiagnosePage — alignment scope, noise fingerprint, integrity views
description:
Implement Align and Diagnose diagnostic pages (spec §20.2–20.3, §20.5–20.6, §21.4).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §13 DI Key Alignment calibration workflow and §20.2 DI Alignment Scope
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.3 Noise Fingerprint, §20.5 Rejected-Signal Audition, §20.6 Analyzer Controls
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §19 attack/tail integrity concepts and phase-H analyzers
- Source/Analysis/AlignmentScopeData.* , NoiseFingerprint.* , AttackIntegrityAnalyzer.* , TailIntegrityAnalyzer.* APIs from phase h
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for lookahead / alignmentOffset / rejected audition params if present
- Source/GUI/ChugLookAndFeel.h from i.1

Implement AlignPage.h/.cpp:
- juce::Component showing DI alignment scope: key onset vs main-audio onset waveforms, correlation curve, selected offset, confidence, offset variation, and resulting key delay or main lookahead readout when AlignmentScopeData is attached (null-safe placeholders otherwise).
- Calibrate / Align button and Accept / Retry / Manual trim controls via callbacks + APVTS binding for key.alignmentOffset and global.lookahead where IDs exist.
- Message-thread-only painting from snapshot/copy APIs on AlignmentScopeData.

Implement DiagnosePage.h/.cpp:
- juce::Component sections for: Noise Fingerprint display (from NoiseFingerprint), rejected-signal audition routing controls (mode choices per §20.5 if params/hooks exist), AttackIntegrityAnalyzer and TailIntegrityAnalyzer metric readouts (missed attacks, chopped tails, etc. as exposed by analyzer getters).
- Analyzer quality/layer toggles (Off/Live/Studio/Diagnose) if wired through processor/editor callbacks — use std::function setters rather than editing PluginProcessor here.
- Null-safe when analysis objects not yet injected.

Do NOT implement MainHeader/PluginEditor/CMakeLists or other pages.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: AlignPage paints alignment scope content from AlignmentScopeData when set and remains null-safe otherwise
AlignPage provides Calibrate/Align action control and binds alignment offset and/or lookahead when ParameterIDs exist
DiagnosePage displays NoiseFingerprint content and attack/tail integrity readouts when analysis objects are set
DiagnosePage exposes rejected-signal audition and/or analyzer mode controls via attachments or editor callbacks
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: custom paint for scope/fingerprint using pre-copied float buffers
callback hooks for calibrate and analyzer mode without touching processor internals
APVTS attachments for alignment/lookahead/rejected-route params that already exist
forbidden: reimplement correlation or noise FFT inside the page
own editor shell or CMakeLists target_sources
block audio thread from GUI timers
